headline.purpose: The one hero/page-title size — trip titles, page H1s, modal titles.

label.purpose: Condensed, tracked, cased nav/tag/section-head voice. Never body copy.

body.purpose: All reading copy on the system font stack for cross-generational legibility.

shadows.name: slide-shadow
shadows.purpose: The single elevation shadow shared by every .cx-slide panel/card.

shadows.name: lit-ring
shadows.purpose: Marks the one 'live right now' element per view, paired with the cx-sweep animation.

motion.name: cx-sweep
motion.value: linear-gradient sweep, translateX(-130%) to translateX(130%), 3.6s ease-in-out infinite
motion.purpose: The system's one authored motion moment — a light sweeping across the active position. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber-filled primary action button, condensed tracked label type.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Archivo Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-weight: 700; background: #dda233; color: #17130f; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dda233; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: 'Archivo Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-weight: 700; background: #d1502c; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The signature translucent, blurred, single-shadow card surface (.cx-slide).
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(34,26,16,0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid rgba(60,46,24,0.45); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 14px 32px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); padding: 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-panel-label { font-family: 'Archivo Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; color: #8c7d63; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-panel-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #f7ecd9; }

components.name: Raked Hero Slide
components.description: The signature parallelogram-clipped panel with the 'lit' active-state ring and sweep, as used for the near-edge trip in the Trips rack.
components.css: .ds-slide-raked { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(34,26,16,0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid rgba(60,46,24,0.45); border-radius: 14px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 2.5rem), calc(100% - 2.5rem) 100%, 0 100%); padding: 16px; } .ds-lit { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d99a1f, 0 0 20px -4px #d99a1f; } .ds-lit::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 35%, rgba(247,236,217,0.55) 50%, transparent 65%); animation: ds-sweep 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes ds-sweep { 0%, 15% { transform: translateX(-130%); } 65%, 100% { transform: translateX(130%); } } .ds-slide-title { font-family: 'Archivo Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 1.75rem; color: #f7ecd9; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-lit::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard themed text field with amber focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #15100a; color: #f7ecd9; border: 1px solid #3c2e18; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #dda233; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8c7d63; }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Small rounded state-tone chip; tone follows meaning (gold/green/vermilion/neutral).
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: 'Archivo Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid; } .ds-tag-gold { background: rgba(221,162,51,0.15); color: #dda233; border-color: rgba(221,162,51,0.3); } .ds-tag-green { background: rgba(31,111,74,0.15); color: #1f6f4a; border-color: rgba(31,111,74,0.3); } .ds-tag-vermilion { background: rgba(209,80,44,0.15); color: #d1502c; border-color: rgba(209,80,44,0.3); }

components.name: Bottom Navigation (in-trip)
components.description: Fixed 8-item icon-only bottom nav for the 8 trip surfaces; amber active state with top indicator pill.
components.css: .ds-bottomnav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: #221a10; border-top: 1px solid #3c2e18; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); } .ds-navitem { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 64px; flex: 1; min-width: 44px; color: #8c7d63; } .ds-navitem-active { color: #dda233; } .ds-navitem-indicator { position: absolute; top: 0; height: 2px; width: 24px; background: #dda233; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview: Concourse reads a family trip the way an airport departures board reads a flight: one shared surface, one prose register ranked by weight/case/rule instead of a size ramp, panels leaning off a common raked axis like boards seen at an angle, and a single light sweep marking whichever position is live right now (the current trip, the active tab, today's marker). The ground is warm goldenrod/amber, not the generic dark-slate-and-teal SaaS dashboard the redesign explicitly rejects; surfaces are tinted glass slides — translucent, blurred to whatever sits behind them — rather than opaque cards. Night mode is the board unlit (carbon ground, amber-lit panel edges), not an inverted palette swap. The system is deliberately restrained in its type scale (two heading sizes, everything else carried by weight/case/tracking) and deliberately committed in its geometry (the raked parallelogram edge recurs on hero bands, the trip rack, and headers as the one signature silhouette). It is built to work for a grandparent and a teenager on the same screen: 16px minimum body text and 44px minimum touch targets are load-bearing accessibility floors, not incidental choices.
keyCharacteristics: Warm amber/goldenrod ground in both themes; dark mode is the board at night, not an inverted palette
Tinted glass panels (.cx-slide) with backdrop blur, never opaque flat cards
One raked (parallelogram) edge as the system's signature silhouette, applied to hero bands, headers, and the trip rack
Two-step heading scale; rank below that carried by weight, case, and rule — not more sizes
One authored motion moment (the sweeping light, .cx-lit) reserved for 'this is live right now'

rules.name: The Amber-Not-Teal Rule
rules.body: The single interactive accent is always warm amber/goldenrod, tuned per theme (#dda233 dark, #9c5c17 light). It is never rendered as literal teal, despite the brand-teal token name carried forward for repoint compatibility.

rules.name: The Four-State-Colors Rule
rules.body: Vermilion (danger), bottle-green (positive), goldenrod, and carbon/ivory (contrast-on-photo) are the only fixed-regardless-of-theme colors. They exist because state meaning (delete vs. confirm) must read the same in both themes; no other color is theme-invariant.

rules.name: The Two-Step Scale Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two heading sizes (cx-h1, cx-h2). Everything ranked below that is carried by weight, case, and rule (cx-label), never by adding a third size.

rules.name: The Label-Is-Not-Body Rule
rules.body: cx-label (condensed, uppercase, tracked) is reserved for tags, nav, and section captions. Reading copy always uses the body stack, never the display face at small sizes.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every panel carries the same .cx-slide shadow; elevation is not tiered by importance. Importance is instead signaled by the .cx-lit ring/sweep, a separate and rarer device.

dos: Do use .cx-slide for every card/panel surface — glass translucency + blur + the one shared shadow, never an opaque flat card.
Do reserve .cx-lit (glow ring + sweep) for exactly one 'this is live' element per view (active trip, active tab, primary FAB) — its rarity is what makes it legible.
Do carry rank through weight/case/tracking (cx-label vs. cx-h1/cx-h2) rather than adding a third heading size.
Do keep the raked edge (.cx-rake/.cx-rake-b) on the same shared lean axis everywhere it appears — hero bands, headers, the rack's hero slide.
Do hold the 16px body-text and 44px touch-target floors on every new surface; they are durable accessibility constraints, not legacy leftovers.
donts: Don't invert the palette for dark mode. Dark mode is the unlit board (carbon ground, amber-lit edges); it is a different lighting state of the same amber world, not a color swap.
Don't use vermilion as a primary CTA color — it is reserved for destructive/danger meaning only.
Don't stack a border and a shadow as two separate elevation signals on the same panel; .cx-slide's border is a glass edge, not a second depth cue.
Don't treat the condensed display face (cx-label/cx-headline) as a body-copy font at small sizes; body copy stays on the system stack for cross-generational legibility.
